authors: Liyang Tang; Qishen Li; Hua Huang; Qiufeng Li; Xiong Ying
summary: To address the low detection accuracy caused by the prevalent small object scales and highly dense distributions in UAV aerial imagery, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv10n-based small-object detection algorithm for aerial-view scenarios, termed GC-YOLO. In terms of network design, we develop a Global Path Aggregation Feature Pyramid Network (GPAFPN), which strengthens information interaction among multi-scale features and effectively enriches spatial localization cues and fine-grained details for small objects.
